artworks.title: Clytemnestra
artworks.description: Collier's Clytemnestra stands with the axe after the bath-murder — the homecoming of Agamemnon that opens the bitter Returns from Troy.

artworks.title: The Return of Odysseus
artworks.description: Ge paints the last and longest return — Odysseus unrecognized at his threshold, while the Nostoi episode tells how the other kings fared when Troy was already ash.
